home.title: Welcome to ADK
home.body: Welcome to the new homepage of the SSV of Allee der Kosmonauten 20! Here you can find information about the dormitory and of course about the offers of the SSV.
about.heading: About the SSV
about.intro: SSV is ADKs self-administration that exists to improve the student life in the dormitory. We are using our means to organize parties in the dormitory, video evenings, sports, trips and cultural offers. In addition, we are running the laundry and selling the necessary cards, renting out games and providing a possiblity for guests to stay in our guest rooms.
about.participateBody: You can join us by just coming to the next SSV meeting! There are lots of ways how you can participate.
about.meetingsBody: You can have a look at the minutes of the last meeting in the SSV office at the office opening hours.
about.meetingsCallout: The meetings always take place on the first Monday of every month, at 8 PM in the Keller (house 15 in the basement). You are invited to come and join us!
about.officeIntro: In the office of the SSV, you can
about.officeItem1: get a card for the washing machines, recharge it or give it back
about.officeItem3: get a key for the sports room
about.officeItem5: ask any questions concerning the SSV
about.officeItem6: find a contact person for problems you might encounter in the dormitory
about.visitInfo: Just visit us in the SSV office at these hours. It is situated in house 15, floor 0.

instructionsCard.usageStep1: After putting your clothes into the machine, selecting the fitting program and filling in the detergent, close the door of the machine.
instructionsCard.usageStep2: The machine will now ask you to pay. Insert your laundry card into the box on top of the machine. Make sure that the chip is on the bottom and in front.
instructionsCard.usageStep3: First press the + button on the box and then the OK button. As soon as "on" appears on the display, remove your card.
instructionsCard.usageStep4: Press the start button on the machine. Come back when the machine is finished (the duration is on the display of the machine).
instructionsCard.usageStep5: If you have used a dryer, clean the fluff filter after you're finished! Read the instructions on top of the dryers.
instructionsCard.infoParagraph1: The SSV is running a room with washing machines and dryers for you. It is located in the basement between the houses 23 and 24. There are 5 washing machines and 3 dryers that you can use.
instructionsCard.infoParagraph2Before: To use them, you need a laundry card. You can get it at the
instructionsCard.infoParagraph2After: against a deposit of 15€. You also need to charge it with an amount of money to be able to wash. For 1€, you get 2 points on the card.
instructionsCard.infoParagraph3: Washing costs 4 points (2€), drying costs 2 points (1€).
instructionsCard.infoParagraph4: Made a mistake - wrong machine, wrong time? Just scan the QR code again and enter the correct time; it overwrites what was there. This runs on an honor system, so please only use it to fix genuine mistakes, not to cut someone else's cycle short.
instructionsCard.infoParagraph5: When you move out, you can return your card at the office and get your deposit back, if the card is not physically damaged (e.g. bent or ruptured). We can't give you your remaining credit back, so make sure that you don't charge too much.
